[Rating: 5/10] Ok puzzle racing game, but a lot depends on what cards you draw.  Kinda like Tsuro, less chaotic, but also way slower and limited to 4 player.  Turn order doesn't seem to be an advantage, so I'm not sure why the tie breaker goes to the finishing player farthest from start player.

[Rating: 5.5/10] I actually really like the gameplay and puzzle of trying to get your ship home. I hate the ending where it is a race to the station and the tie breakers. It was so very unsatisfying that I wouldn't want to play again.

[Rating: 5.5/10] tile placement race game place tile with an aim to get to the finishing tile  some action cards and new tiles provide more variation quite chaotic

[Rating: 6/10] The game is very tactical with enough to consider on your turn for a light filler. It's heavily dependent on cards draws, but the game is short enough for that not to be an issue.

[Rating: 6/10] A very simple game mechanically, but there's a good bit of tactics that you can find with the cards. There is a decent amount of randomness that can make it feel a bit lucky sometimes though, and the way ties are resolved makes the game drag a little longer than it probably should sometimes as the last player to make it to base is the winner. There seems to almost be a first player disadvantage in that sense which is rare for boardgames.

[Rating: 6/10] Race game where you play cards to try make better path for you and disturb, slow down other players. It is quite lucky and chaotic, could be fun filler for 4 players.

[Rating: 7/10] Jeu acheté sur le tard sur Ulule, reçu assez rapidement. J'ai testé le jeu seulement à deux, mais les parties sont amusantes, assez intense et courte, ce qui nous donne l'envie de rejouer juste après.  Game purchased latelly on Ulule, received quickly enough. Played only with my girlfriend, but the games are fun, intense and short enough to incitate us to play again just after I loose (or win, less frequently)
